name: CrossLink Pixel
summary: Pixel-style e-reader firmware focused on smooth reading and Chinese text layout.
description: CrossLink Pixel brings a pixel-style reading interface to reTerminal Sticky. Its reading-focused design emphasizes e-ink refresh, Chinese text layout, page turns, text rendering, and quick startup.

compatibility.notes: Requires 32 MB flash. The supplied image writes the first 16 MB and defines a storage partition in the second 16 MB. The contributor flashed this package to a physical reTerminal Sticky and confirmed it booted and ran normally.

notes.title: Before installation
notes.description: This package requires a reTerminal Sticky with 32 MB flash. Back up device data before replacing the first 16 MB of flash.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: Connect the device with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge. Write the complete CrossLink Pixel image at offset 0x0.
